reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Mast cells -> found in connective tissue -> Conjunctive -> 80% CHAIN: Mast cells -> originate from the bone marrow -> migrate to various tissues -> found in all tissues including epithelial, connective, and adipose tissue -> Conjunctive -> 70% CHAIN: Mast cells -> part of the immune system -> found in all tissues including lymphoid tissue -> Lymphoid -> 80%
analysis: Mast cells are a type of white blood cell and are part of the immune system. They are found in connective tissue and play a key role in allergic reactions and inflammation.
